text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Mubarak: the government will take strict and immediate measures against building violations and circumventing the law. He says after a three-hour tour in the Sinai resort Dahab: we're committed to development and providing means of living for the citizens. Construction of an airport between Dahab and Nuweiba to facilitate tourism and investment.

- The president discusses with Primakov the Russian role in the peace process. Moussa: the Egyptian-Russia cooperation will be stronger in the economic conference. Primakov: returing to point zero in the negotiations will give violence a chance to erupt.
- Primakov says in a lecture: Israel has not done anything to implement the Madrid and Oslo accords.
- Owner and collapsed building and his three engineers detained for another 45 days.
- Mubarak: We are working towards fulfilling all our promises to the people. A committee, headed by Prime Minister Ganzouri, to draft a plan for Egypt's coastline.
- Government to give families of those killed in collapsed Cairo building 3,000 pounds.
- Mubarak says after meeting Primakov: Russia can take a role in the peace process.
- Strict measures to counteract building violations.
- Egypt, United States to hold "Iron Snake" military exercises.
